errorBoundary.description: An unexpected error occurred. Reload to continue, or share the error reference below with support.

auth_invalid.what: Authentication failed: the session or API key was rejected.
auth_invalid.responsibility: Your account or credentials are the problem, not a Verse Claw defect.
auth_invalid.nextStep: Sign in again or re-enter the API key in Settings, then retry.

auth_permanent.what: The provider permanently rejected this API key.
auth_permanent.responsibility: The credential is invalid or revoked, so retrying cannot help.
auth_permanent.nextStep: Replace the API key for this provider in Settings, then retry.

timeout.what: The request timed out before the provider answered.
timeout.responsibility: The network or the provider answered too slowly.
timeout.nextStep: The action may already have completed upstream; check the result before retrying.

rate_limit.what: The provider is rate limiting requests right now.
rate_limit.responsibility: This is the provider's pacing or quota limit, not a Verse Claw defect.

permission.what: Permission was denied for this action.
permission.responsibility: Your local configuration or account role does not allow it.
permission.nextStep: Review the related permission or setting, then retry.

channel_unavailable.responsibility: A local part of the app did not answer.
channel_unavailable.nextStep: Restart the app or gateway, then retry.

conversation_state.what: The provider rejected the conversation state.
conversation_state.responsibility: The session transcript no longer matches what the provider expects.
conversation_state.nextStep: Start a new session; retrying the same turn will fail again.

network.responsibility: The connection between the app and the service is broken.

config.responsibility: A setting value is missing or malformed.
config.nextStep: Fix the setting in Settings, then retry.

gateway.responsibility: The local OpenClaw gateway is not running or not ready.
gateway.nextStep: Start or restart the gateway, then retry.

billing.what: The provider account has insufficient balance or quota.
billing.responsibility: This is a billing or quota problem on your provider account.
billing.nextStep: Top up the provider account or switch provider or model; retrying now will not help.

overloaded.responsibility: The provider is temporarily under heavy load.
overloaded.nextStep: Wait a short while and retry, or switch to another model.

model_not_found.what: The selected model is not available for this provider.
model_not_found.responsibility: The model id or provider routing is wrong, or the model was retired.
model_not_found.nextStep: Pick another model in the model picker, then retry.

unknown.responsibility: The cause could not be identified locally.
unknown.nextStep: Retry once; if it happens again, share the error reference with support.
